records.description: The project rebranded from Gnosis Safe to Safe after spinning out from GnosisDAO; Safe states that the protocol, audited contracts, accounts, funds, and security model did not change.
records.title: Gnosis Safe rebranded to Safe

records.amount_text: Approximately $1.46 billion from Bybit's affected Ethereum cold wallet
records.description: A targeted compromise of a Safe{Wallet} developer workstation and Safe{Wallet} web-delivery infrastructure enabled malicious JavaScript to manipulate a Bybit Safe transaction on 2025-02-21. The manipulated transaction resulted in approximately $1.46 billion in assets leaving Bybit's affected Ethereum cold wallet.
records.notes: The product boundary is Safe{Wallet} Web. Safe stated that external forensic review did not identify vulnerabilities in Safe smart contracts or in the source code of the frontend/services. Sygnia describes the incident as a supply-chain compromise and traces the attack path from a compromised Safe developer workstation through Safe AWS access to injected JavaScript served from app.safe.global. The malicious code was highly targeted to the Bybit Safe; this record does not generalize the impact to all Safe accounts or Safe Mobile.
records.title: Safe{Wallet} Web supply-chain compromise enabled targeted Bybit transaction manipulation

records.description: Safe reported that the Safe{Wallet} team fully rebuilt and reconfigured infrastructure, rotated all credentials, eliminated the identified attack vector, and restored Safe{Wallet} on Ethereum mainnet with a phased rollout and additional security measures.
records.notes: This remediation is infrastructure- and credential-based, so WLR does not invent an affected-version or fixed-version range. The 2025-02-28 date is the public disclosure date of the completed rebuild/credential-rotation boundary, not an asserted exact completion timestamp for every remediation action.
records.title: Safe{Wallet} rebuilt infrastructure and rotated credentials after targeted compromise

records.notes: Official Safe Ecosystem Foundation statement reproducing the Safe{Wallet} team's preliminary findings: compromised Safe{Wallet} developer machine, disguised malicious transaction, no identified Safe smart-contract or frontend/services source-code vulnerability, full infrastructure rebuild/reconfiguration, credential rotation and phased restoration.
records.title: February 28th, 2025: Statement by the Safe Ecosystem Foundation

records.notes: Investigator-authored account documenting the compromised Safe developer workstation, stolen AWS access, malicious JavaScript injected into Safe{Wallet}'s S3-delivered web resources, the targeted Bybit activation condition and the conclusion that the incident traced back to a supply-chain compromise.
records.title: Bybit – What We Know So Far

records.notes: First-party victim timeline establishing the 2025-02-21 incident, approximately $1.46B asset loss from the affected Ethereum cold wallet, Safe's temporary Wallet pause, and the later forensic finding of malicious JavaScript on the Safe{Wallet} platform.
records.title: Bybit Security Incident: Timeline of Events and FAQs
